a.xlink:title: Fills _aiCommands with the AI protocol commands and their durations.
Broadcasts text to every other player, tagged with the direction it came from.
Returns the number of free team connection slots (the "Connect_nbr" command).
Pushes every other player off the current tile.
Lays an egg on the current tile, opening a new team slot.
Moves the player one tile forward in its current facing.
Returns the player's inventory (resource counts and remaining life).
Attempts to start an elevation ritual on the current tile (see beginIncantation).
Turns the player 90° to the left.
Returns what the player sees on the tiles within its vision cone.
Turns the player 90° to the right.
Drops a named resource from the inventory onto the current tile.
Picks up a named resource from the current tile into the inventory.
Queues a message to be delivered to a receiver after timeNeeded elapses.
Direction from this player toward another player, accounting for wrap-around.
Shortest tile distance to another player on the toroidal map.
The socket fd linking this player to its client (for I/O only).
This player's stable logical id (its GUI player number).
Map dimensions as (width, height).
Looks up a player by its logical id, or nullptr if none matches.
Returns the logical id of this client's player, or -1 if it has none.
All players currently in the world.
Prints one log line to stdout. Omits the "(...)" group when fields is empty.
Orders the pending-message queue by the time each message needs to arrive.
Current tile position.
Current facing, in degrees (see Degrees).
Number of free connection slots remaining.
Builds a passive "pipi" snapshot line (position, orientation, level, inventory) for one player.
Builds a "ppo" broadcast line (position, orientation) for one player.
Returns the tile at the given coordinates.
True if at least one egg is currently sitting on the given tile.
Tile the player would land on if it moved one step forward, with wrap-around.
Removes eggs at a tile (and their slots). With eggID set, removes just that one egg; with count == -1...
Sends a message to every player currently standing on the given tile.
Places the player at (x, y), wrapping into the map bounds.
Sets the absolute count of a resource on a tile.
This player's inventory.
Current elevation level (1..8).
Lays count eggs at the given tile, each adding a slot and a unique ID.
Adds the player pointer to the tile at the given position, if it exists.
Moves one tile forward in the current facing, with wrap-around.
Removes the player pointer from the tile at the given position, if any.
Formats the inventory as the protocol inventory reply string.
Returns the held count for an item type.
Builds a "plv" broadcast line (level) for one player.
Returns the players standing on the tile that are exactly at level.
